secondary.method: normalized earning-power capitalization reconciled to actual common-holder cash constraints
secondary.note: No 12-14x prior and no five-year lump-sum asset release. Y3 earnings normalize from Y4 at 1.5%; financial receipts use identical ownership/tax/liquidity/loss and parent constraints. The counterfactual removes only opening and acquired financial surplus, not operational required capital. Both methods share the waterfall and do not independently certify it.

units: CNY billion and billion shares, per share CNY
